content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The salt pans shimmer like a thousand tiny mirrors under Inti (the sun)."},{"poi_id":"p11","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Those circular terraces feel like a giant’s amphitheatre carved into the earth."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"Wander the artisan lanes of San Blas, where tiny workshops spill colour onto the cobbles."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Lose yourself among market stalls piled with fruit, flowers and the hum of local life."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Follow cacao from bean to bar in a little museum that smells like heaven."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Giant Inca stones with a view over the whole city, and a story in every zigzag wall."},{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Gold leaf, cedar carvings and a painting of the Last Supper with a very Andean guest on the plate."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Quiet rooms full of Inca goldwork, quipus and mummies that make history feel very close."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"A dome full of southern stars and the Inca constellations, told with warmth and a little theatre."}]}
Five days of Inti (the sun)-kissed stone, salt and markets, with every must-do tucked in.
